frozen_by: Execution Order of 30 September 2026, item B1 — pre-registered colour rules
note: The colour describes the state of the session; it is not a forecast. Every rule is evaluated mechanically from served data, never by a model; the entry stores the list of rules that fired.

rules.text: S&P 500 down more than 2 percent on the day
VIX up more than 20 percent on the day
book down more than 3 percent on the day
a held name closes below its Chandelier level and its 200-day average on the same day
a high-impact macro release or a held-name earnings release within the next two sessions
regime index rising five sessions in a row
10-year yield above 5 percent or up more than 15 basis points on the day
book down 1.5 to 3 percent on the day
a held name within 3 percent of its 200-day average

definitions.chandelier: 22-session high minus 3 × ATR(22) on the provider's OHLC bars; when OHLC is unavailable the true range falls back to the close-to-close range and the level is flagged. The rulebook's trailing level (peak × (1 − bracket)) is recorded beside it and is not the Chandelier level.
definitions.book_change: Σ shares × (close − prior close) over the prior session's NAV, on the current holdings with cash unchanged
definitions.regime_index: R_t from regime_daily.csv (the continuous revised series) for the rising streak; the published vintage's R and label beside it; the label thresholds are the NAV job's (0.30 / 0.50 / 0.70)
definitions.flags: complacency and shock from intraday.json when it is reconciled to the session, else recomputed from the canonical closes by the same rules (SKEW > 140 and VIX < 17; VIX +15%, SPX −1.5%, term backwardation, duration-adjusted HY −1%)
definitions.within_two_sessions: the two trading sessions after the brief's session; releases and held-name earnings dated on those sessions
definitions.next_events: the next three calendar events of impact high or medium after the session
definitions.yield: the latest 10-year constant-maturity yield in the FRED store on or before the session (FRED publishes with a lag; the date is stored)

narrative.validator: rejects the entry if any number in the text is absent from the payload after rounding, if it contains a forecast verb, if it names a security not in the payload, if it exceeds the word limit, or if it contains a directive or prohibited vocabulary; on rejection the template sentence is used and the rejection is logged
